scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
恭喜。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
We Knights have an
awesome responsibility...
To serve and protect.
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
我们骑士肩负着重大的责任...
为人效力，守护他人。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Even at the cost
of our own lives,
we must safeguard the
well being of our comrades.
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
即使牺牲自己的生命，也要守护战友的安危。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Your time has come!
The world still needs you.
Please continue your life
as a hero with a new appearance.
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
属于你的时刻到了！
世界依然需要你。
请以全新的姿态，继续你的英雄之路。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Would you like
to become a Lord Knight?
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
你想成为骑士领主吗？

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
准备好了，随时回来吧。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
你还有可以学习的技能。
请用完剩余的技能点，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Congratulations!
As a Lord Knight,
I hope that you will be
at the forefront of battle,
and lead your allies to victory!
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
恭喜！
愿你身为骑士领主，冲锋在前，带领盟友赢得胜利！

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Lord Knight]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[骑士领主]
在这里安心休息吧。
向战士们致敬！
